### 修复细节 / Fix details

- **#55：修复 Linux 分数缩放下拖动窗口时尺寸持续变化。** 拖动时使用固定目标宽高；连续多轮拖动保留该目标，避免将系统读回的取整误差继续累积。用户主动调整窗口大小后采用新尺寸；光标静止时跳过移窗，窗口销毁、最大化或全屏时停止拖动。
- **#55: Prevent cumulative window-size drift while dragging on Linux at fractional scaling.** Moves use fixed target dimensions, retained across gestures so native geometry rounding does not accumulate. Explicit user resizing establishes a new target. Stationary cursors do not trigger updates, and dragging stops when the window is destroyed, maximized, or fullscreen.
- 基于 devinhurry 在 #55 提出的修复方向，进一步补齐多轮拖动的误差隔离和回归测试。感谢贡献。
- Based on devinhurry's proposed fix in #55, with additional protection and regression coverage for rounding across separate gestures.

### 验证与未验收范围 / Validation and limitations

- Linux 环境全量 134 个测试文件 / 973 项测试、Electron ABI 110 数据库自测、双端类型检查、构建、启动冒烟、版本一致性和双语文档检查通过。
- 实际 Electron 22.3.27 在 Xvfb / 125% 缩放下通过生产 preload/IPC 验证：40 次移动、10 轮拖动不再累积尺寸误差，主动调整窗口大小和结束拖动均正常。原实现同场景由 960×640 增长至约 1039×720。
- Electron 原生坐标换算仍可能产生最多 2 DIP 的非累积尺寸差异。本次环境验证不覆盖 UOS ARM64 物理桌面及 Windows/macOS 真机；跨平台构建由发布工作流验证。
- 本版本不包含 #68 的 Wayland 文件柜卡住问题修复。
- Local Linux validation passed: 973 tests across 134 files, the Electron ABI 110 database self-test, both type checks, production build, startup smoke, version consistency, and documentation locale checks.
- Actual Electron 22.3.27 under Xvfb at 125% scaling was exercised through the production preload/IPC: 40 moves and 10 separate gestures no longer accumulate size errors; explicit resizing and ending the gesture behave correctly. The original implementation grew a 960×640 window to roughly 1039×720 in the same scenario.
- Native Electron geometry conversion can still produce up to 2 DIP of non-accumulating size rounding. This environment does not cover a physical UOS ARM64 desktop or Windows/macOS hardware; the release workflow validates cross-platform builds.
- This release does not fix the separate Wayland file-cabinet freeze reported in #68.
